title: Missing moneylending collector found dead in Lanao del Sur

blocks.text: PARANG, Maguindanao del Norte — Police found the body of a missing moneylending collector buried in a shallow grave in a pineapple plantation in Wao, Lanao del Sur, on Friday afternoon, police said. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), identified the victim as Marvin Muñez Daumar, 36, a collector for JDS Lending Co. and a resident of Barangay Batangan, Valencia City, Bukidnon. Salanguit said police recovered Daumar’s body in Barnaby Buntongan, Wao, after receiving information about a suspected cadaver discovered by residents.
